description: Department of Archaeology - The Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188) The order made under Section 18 (The Monuments to be declared as protected Monuments - Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188) Order made under Section 16 (The list of Monuments which shall be declared as Ancient Monuments)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of monuments as "Protected Monuments" and "Ancient Monuments" under the Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188). It constitutes a regulatory action by the Minister exercising powers vested by existing legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on establishing legal protections for specific cultural heritage sites through statutory instruments.
